axes.name: Guardrail-first discipline

axes.name: Genuine deduplication

axes.name: Repro-first discipline

axes.name: Fix minimality

axes.name: Honest verification

notes: Speeds are engine-log rates per trial (llama-server timings), excluding tool and scheduling time; wall time includes them.

Admission-probe speeds on the page are separate from these per-trial medians.
